title: Plugin System, Agent View, Background Sessions
description: Major updates including plugin dependency enforcement, agent view for session management, enhanced background session persistence, and numerous UI/UX improvements. Windows PowerShell tool now enabled by default for Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry users.

title: REST API for Cloud Agent Tasks
description: May 13, 2026: Copilot Business and Enterprise users can programmatically start Copilot cloud agent tasks with the new Agent tasks REST API, available in public preview. The API makes it easy to weave Copilot cloud agent into custom automations like refactoring across repositories, setting up new repos from dev portals, and automated release preparation.

title: Copilot Code Review Comment Experience Improvements
description: May 12, 2026: Improvements to the code review comment experience in GitHub Copilot.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Fast Mode, Devin Review Integration
description: May 12, 2026 (v2.2.17): Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) now available with ~2.5x higher output speeds. Devin Review and Quick Review available to all users with 2-week free trial. Agent Command Center improvements with list display option and improved sorting/filtering. Windows bug fixes and MCP server fixes.

title: Grok Code Fast 1 Deprecation, More Flexible Cloud Agent Secrets
description: May 8, 2026: Grok Code Fast 1 deprecated across all Copilot experiences (deprecation date: May 15, 2026). Recommended alternatives: GPT-5 mini / Claude Haiku 4.5. Also: More flexible secrets and variables for Copilot cloud agent.

title: Multiple Model Deprecations
description: May 7, 2026: Upcoming deprecations including GPT-4.1 and Claude Sonnet 4. Rubber Duck mode in Copilot CLI now supports more models.

title: GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex Deprecation
description: May 1, 2026: Upcoming deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex models.

title: Development Environments, Multi-Repo Support, Teams Integration
description: May 2026 updates: Development environments for cloud agents with isolated containers, multi-repo environments support, environment configuration as code with Dockerfile improvements, Cursor in Microsoft Teams integration, Bugbot Effort Levels customization, PR Review experience improvements, parallel plan execution, and Split PRs feature.

title: Devin Review & Quick Review Available to All, Agent Command Center
description: May 6, 2026 (v2.2.17): Devin Review and Quick Review now available to all Windsurf IDE users with existing subscription. Devin Review includes 2-week free trial for self-serve users. Agent Command Center improvements including list display option, improved sessions sidebar sorting/filtering, and performance improvements.
